Spring Fragrance entertained as old-fashioned notions concerning marriage as did the Chin Yuen parents.

The reason for this was that, although the Chin Yuen parents lived in a house furnished in American style, and wore American clothes, yet they religiously observed many Chinese customs, and their ideals of life were the ideals of their Chinese forefathers.
